newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-SLOVENIA BEAT AUSTRIA 2-0 IN FRIENDLY INTERNATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVENIA BEAT AUSTRIA 2-0 IN FRIENDLY INTERNATIONAL.

text.p: Slovenia beat Austria 2-0 (halftime 0-0) in a friendly internatonal soccer match Tuesday.

Austria - Michael Konsel (Franz Wohlfahrt 46), Goran Kartalija, Peter Schoettel, Anton Pfeffer, Markus Schopp, Harald Cerny, Andreas Heraf (Heimo Pfeiffenberger 46), Adi Huetter (Peter Stoeger 23, Roman Maehlich 65), Franz Aigner, Anton Polster, Andreas Herzog (Herfried Sabitzer 40)

Slovenia - Bosko Boskovic (Mladen Dabanovic 89), Robert Englaro, Miran Srebrnic (Andrej Poljsak 90, Ales Krizan, Alfred Jermanis, Damjan Gajser (Amir Karic 65), Ales Ceh (Milinovic 90), Saso Udovic (Simon Seslar 59), Doni Novak, Primoz Gliha (Vladimir Kokol 79), Matjaz Florjancic (Ermin Siljak 46)
